# S3eidat Tools MCP

> S3eidat Tools as a local MCP server: PDF, image, text, developer and calculator tools for AI assistants. Runs on your machine; files are never uploaded.

Install: `npx -y s3eidat-tools-mcp` (stdio MCP server; `--http` for Streamable HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8787/mcp). Claude Code: `claude mcp add s3eidat -- npx -y s3eidat-tools-mcp`.
File inputs: local path or base64. File outputs: written to the given `output` path (or a temp folder); results return the path. No network, no telemetry.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/s3eidat/s3eidat-tools-mcp#readme): install for every AI client
- [Tools reference](https://s3eidat.github.io/s3eidat-tools-mcp/tools.md): every tool with inputs, outputs, examples
- [Tools JSON](https://s3eidat.github.io/s3eidat-tools-mcp/tools.json): machine-readable schemas
- [Skill](https://github.com/s3eidat/s3eidat-tools-mcp/tree/main/skills/s3eidat-tools): which tool for which job
- [Web tools](https://s3eidat.github.io/): the same tools in the browser, for humans

## PDF

- `pdf_compress`: Compress PDF (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-compress/)
- `pdf_extract_pages`: Extract PDF pages (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-split/)
- `pdf_form_fields`: List PDF form fields (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-fill/)
- `pdf_form_fill`: Fill a PDF form (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-fill/)
- `pdf_from_images`: Images to PDF (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/images-to-pdf/)
- `pdf_info`: PDF info
- `pdf_merge`: Merge PDFs (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-merge/)
- `pdf_metadata_read`: Read PDF metadata (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-metadata/)
- `pdf_metadata_write`: Edit or strip PDF metadata (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-metadata/)
- `pdf_organize`: Organize PDF pages (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-organizer/)
- `pdf_page_numbers`: Add page numbers (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-page-numbers/)
- `pdf_rotate`: Rotate PDF pages (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-organizer/)
- `pdf_sign_image`: Sign PDF with an image (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-sign/)
- `pdf_split`: Split PDF (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-split/)
- `pdf_to_images`: PDF to images (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-to-images/)
- `pdf_to_text`: PDF to text (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-to-text/)
- `pdf_watermark`: Watermark PDF (web: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-watermark/)

## For AI agents

- `ai_chart`: Chart to SVG/PNG
- `ai_chunk_text`: Chunk text for RAG
- `ai_create_pptx`: Create a PowerPoint deck
- `ai_create_xlsx`: Create an Excel workbook (.xlsx)
- `ai_csv_profile`: Profile a table (CSV, JSON, XLSX)
- `ai_detect_language`: Detect language
- `ai_diagram`: Diagram to SVG/PNG
- `ai_docx_to_markdown`: Word (.docx) to Markdown
- `ai_extract_entities`: Extract entities
- `ai_file_identify`: Identify a file type
- `ai_html_to_markdown`: HTML to Markdown
- `ai_image_diff`: Compare two images
- `ai_json_schema_infer`: Infer a JSON Schema from samples
- `ai_json_schema_validate`: Validate JSON against a JSON Schema
- `ai_markdown_to_docx`: Markdown to Word (.docx)
- `ai_markdown_to_pdf`: Markdown to PDF
- `ai_media_info`: Audio/video metadata
- `ai_ocr`: OCR (image or scanned PDF to text)
- `ai_pdf_to_markdown`: PDF to Markdown
- `ai_pptx_to_markdown`: PowerPoint (.pptx) to Markdown
- `ai_sql_query`: SQL query over tables
- `ai_text_similarity`: Text similarity and near-duplicates
- `ai_token_count`: Count tokens
- `ai_web_fetch`: Fetch a web page as Markdown
- `ai_xlsx_to_markdown`: Excel (.xlsx/.csv) to Markdown tables
- `ai_zip`: ZIP create / extract / list
